conditions.summary: Opening dialogue is available after the first broadcast.

lines.speaker: MaraVoss
lines.responseText: You heard it too. Good. Means I'm not losing my mind—or at least not alone.

lines.speaker: MaraVoss
lines.promptText: What exactly did the broadcast say?
lines.responseText: Three names, a time, and a place. Then yours. Same format the NCR used for casualty traffic, except this signal is older than the Republic.

lines.speaker: MaraVoss
lines.responseText: No. Lone Wolf is only catching the spill. Somebody woke up a stronger relay and aimed it through every dead repeater in the valley.

lines.speaker: MaraVoss
lines.promptText: [Science 45] A prediction needs data. What is it listening to?

skillGates.summary: Recognize that the system needs a surveillance data source.

lines.responseText: Exactly. Caravan schedules, medical calls, troop chatter, water reports—enough scraps and you can make tomorrow look like prophecy.

lines.speaker: MaraVoss
lines.responseText: Then we start with the first name. If the broadcast is engineering these deaths, there'll be fingerprints before there are bodies.

lines.speaker: MaraVoss
lines.promptText: This sounds like someone else's problem.
lines.responseText: It became yours when the voice said your name. I'll be here when that sinks in.
